_note: Rate scenarios and slider limits. Ace updates this file; never invent rates. If scenarios is empty, the site shows 'Call or chat for today's rates'.

hecm._note: Reverse mortgage calculator assumptions. Margin range confirmed by Ace (Sept 2026: industry standard 2.5% to 2.625%). Closing costs are third-party costs (appraisal, title, escrow, recording, counseling); FHA insurance and origination are calculated from HUD rules. expectedRate: the HECM 'expected rate' from a current partner-lender quote (index + margin). When set, the calculator uses it instead of the 10-year Treasury + margin estimate.
